label.description: The visible text label. Defaults to 'Back to top'. Set to empty string for icon-only display.

href.description: If provided, renders as an anchor link (<a>) targeting the given href. Otherwise renders as a <button>.

variant.description: Visual style for the button variant. Use 'primary' to add the primary color scheme.

iconPosition.description: Position of the arrow icon relative to the label text. Defaults to 'right'.

iconSize.description: Size of the arrow icon. Corresponds to USWDS icon size utilities. Defaults to '2'.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the component.
